summary: Onboarding Engine conversion snapshot persistence (Issue #15 Milestone 3). Creates append-only onboarding_snapshot_lines (proposed opening-position rows bound to the snapshot stage completion and run, with batch code, cutoff, source provenance and snapshot sha256; an unsupported_detail row can never name a homeowner) and onboarding_record_snapshot (snapshot result + every line in one transaction; line identity must equal the batch). Replaces onboarding_record_completion (unchanged except a snapshot-stage result must come with its lines) and onboarding_batch_view (latest results carry their summary). Adds onboarding_snapshot_view (read-only; stale flag). Nothing posts to any accounting table. Service_role only. No rows change.

preflight.name: snapshot table does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'onboarding_snapshot_lines'

preflight.name: 482 service functions are in place
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('onboarding_record_completion','onboarding_batch_view')

expected_changes: Creates onboarding_snapshot_lines (append-only; CHECKs on kind, provenance, sha256, unsupported_never_assigned; UNIQUE(completion_event_id, line_no); two indexes; SELECT/INSERT grant).
Creates functions onboarding_record_snapshot and onboarding_snapshot_view (EXECUTE to service_role only).
Replaces onboarding_record_completion (snapshot results only via onboarding_record_snapshot) and onboarding_batch_view (latest_by_stage includes summary).
